officialName: Form for Authorisation of a Patent Agent / or Any Person in a Matter or Proceeding Under the Act
purpose: A power of authority by which an applicant/party authorises a patent agent (or any person) to act on their behalf in a specified matter or proceeding, revokes prior authorisations, and assents to actions already taken.

fee.note: To be stamped under the Indian Stamp Act, 1899 (2 of 1899). No First Schedule fee is printed on the face; the cost is the stamp duty.

layout.notes: Two-column form: left column carries the numbered instructions; right column carries the authorisation with inline blanks. Export must leave room for the stamp.

sections.title: 1. Name, address and nationality of the authorising party

autofill.derivation: Choose 'I' for a single authorising party, 'We' for multiple.

fields.label: Name, address and nationality of the authorising party
fields.helpText: Full name (family/principal name first), complete address incl postal index no./code and state, and nationality.

validation.message: Enter the authorising party's name, address and nationality.

sections.title: 2. Name, address and nationality of the person(s) to be authorized

fields.label: Name, address and nationality of the authorised person(s)
fields.helpText: For a patent agent, include the IN/PA registration number, name and address.

validation.message: Enter the authorised person's name, address and nationality.

sections.title: 3. Particular matter or proceeding
sections.description: Pre-printed: 'to act on my/our behalf in connection with ... and request that all notices, requisitions and communication relating thereto may be sent to such person at the above address unless otherwise specified.'

fields.label: Particular matter or proceeding
fields.helpText: State the particular matter or proceeding (e.g. the application number/subject).

fields.text: and request that all notices, requisitions and communication relating thereto may be sent to such person at the above address unless otherwise specified.
I/We hereby revoke all previous authorisation, if any made, in respect of same matter or proceeding.
I/We hereby assent to the action already taken by the said person in the above-matter.

autofill.derivation: Default to the preparation / signing date; editable.

sections.title: To be signed by the person(s) making this authorisation.
Name of the natural person who has signed, with designation and official seal, if any.

fields.label: Name of the natural person who has signed

validation.message: Enter the full name of the natural person who signed.

fields.text:
To
The Controller of Patents,
The Patent Office,
at

autofill.derivation: Jurisdictional patent office based on the authorising party's address or the office recorded on Form 1.

notes: Note. - To be stamped under the Indian Stamp Act, 1899 (2 of 1899).
Note. - Strike out whichever is not applicable.
This is the Power of Authority referenced by Form 1 §13(i); once on file, the agent's details can pre-fill Form 1 §6 and other forms' signatory blocks.
Capture the signatory's designation and official seal where the authoriser is an organisation.
